meaning.en: With nothing in one's hands; having nothing at all, or gaining nothing.
meaning.zh: 两只手里什么也没有，形容一无所有或毫无收获。

equivalents: with nothing to show for it

examples.zh: 他两手空空来到这座城市打拼。
examples.en: He came to the city to make his way with nothing to his name.

examples.zh: 忙了一整年，最后却两手空空。
examples.en: After a whole year's work, he ended up with nothing to show for it.

examples.zh: 去亲戚家拜年，不能两手空空。
examples.en: You can't visit relatives at New Year empty-handed.

meaning.en: Upright and principled, refusing to curry favour.
meaning.zh: 刚强正直，不逢迎、不偏私。

examples.zh: 这位法官刚正不阿，深受百姓敬重。
examples.en: The judge is upright and incorruptible, and greatly respected.

examples.zh: 他一生刚正不阿，从不向权贵低头。
examples.en: All his life he was unbending and never bowed to the powerful.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 阿 is read ē.

pinyin: fēng mǎ niú bù xiāng jí
literal: stray · horse · ox · not · each other · reach

meaning.en: Things that have nothing whatsoever to do with each other.
meaning.zh: 比喻事物之间毫不相干。

equivalents: have nothing to do with each other

examples.zh: 这两件事风马牛不相及，不要扯在一起。
examples.en: These two things have nothing to do with each other — don't lump them together.

examples.zh: 他的回答和问题风马牛不相及。
examples.en: His answer was completely unrelated to the question.

story.en: When Qi invaded Chu, the Chu envoy protested that their lands were so far apart that 'even stray horses and oxen would not reach each other'.
story.zh: 《左传·僖公四年》：“君处北海，寡人处南海，唯是风马牛不相及也。”

usage.en: Predicate; 风 here means animals straying in heat.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。“风”指牲畜走失。

meaning.en: Left without a word to say, usually because one has been out-argued.
meaning.zh: 像哑巴一样说不出话来，多指被驳得无话可说。

examples.zh: 她一番话驳得对方哑口无言。
examples.en: Her retort left him speechless.

examples.zh: 面对确凿的证据，他哑口无言。
examples.en: Faced with hard evidence, he had nothing to say.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; often 驳得/问得……哑口无言.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，常说“驳得……哑口无言”。

meaning.en: To snatch a little leisure in the middle of a busy schedule.
meaning.zh: 在忙碌中抽出一点空闲时间。

examples.zh: 周末他忙里偷闲，带孩子去了公园。
examples.en: At the weekend he snatched some time to take the kids to the park.

examples.zh: 工作再忙，也要学会忙里偷闲。
examples.en: However busy work gets, you need to learn to take a breather.

meaning.en: Including everything; all-embracing.
meaning.zh: 没有什么不包括在内，形容内容极其丰富。

examples.zh: 这本百科全书内容无所不包。
examples.en: This encyclopaedia covers just about everything.

examples.zh: 他的知识可谓无所不包。
examples.en: His knowledge is truly encyclopaedic.

meaning.en: A helping hand; some assistance.
meaning.zh: 一只胳膊的力量，指一部分力量或帮助。

examples.zh: 如果你需要，我愿助你一臂之力。
examples.en: If you need it, I'm happy to lend a hand.

examples.zh: 多亏朋友助我一臂之力，问题才得以解决。
examples.en: Thanks to a friend's help, the problem was solved.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“助……一臂之力”。

meaning.en: The whole country acting as one coordinated whole, like pieces on a single chessboard.
meaning.zh: 把全国看作一盘棋，统一规划、协调行动。

examples.zh: 抗击疫情要坚持全国一盘棋。
examples.en: Fighting the epidemic requires the whole country to act in concert.

examples.zh: 要树立全国一盘棋的思想。
examples.en: We must think of the whole country as one coordinated whole.

usage.en: Mostly in official and news language.

meaning.en: To hold back and not dare to advance, out of fear or hesitation.
meaning.zh: 停步不敢前进，形容有顾虑而止步。

examples.zh: 面对风险，不少投资者裹足不前。
examples.en: Faced with risk, many investors held back.

examples.zh: 不能因为怕失败就裹足不前。
examples.en: You mustn't hang back for fear of failure.

pinyin: yī nián zhī jì zài yú chūn
literal: one · year · 's · plan · lies · in · spring

meaning.en: The whole year's work depends on a good start in spring; make the most of beginnings.
meaning.zh: 一年的计划要在春天安排好，比喻凡事要在开始时抓紧。

equivalents: a good beginning is half the battle
make hay while the sun shines

examples.zh: 一年之计在于春，新学期要制定好学习计划。
examples.en: A good start is everything — make a study plan for the new term.

examples.zh: 一年之计在于春，农民们已经开始春耕。
examples.en: Spring sets up the whole year, and farmers have already begun ploughing.

usage.en: Often followed by 一日之计在于晨.
usage.zh: 常与“一日之计在于晨”连用。

meaning.en: Looking dazed and absent-minded.
meaning.zh: 精神不集中，神志不清的样子。

examples.zh: 他整夜没睡，第二天神情恍惚。
examples.en: He didn't sleep all night and was in a daze the next day.

examples.zh: 听到噩耗后，她一直神情恍惚。
examples.en: Since hearing the terrible news, she has been in a daze.

meaning.en: Just a few words.
meaning.zh: 几句话，形容话很少。

examples.zh: 这件事三言两语说不清楚。
examples.en: This can't be explained in a few words.

examples.zh: 他三言两语就把问题讲明白了。
examples.en: He explained the problem in just a few words.

antonyms: 一部二十四史，不知从何说起

meaning.en: Scratching an itch through one's boot; ineffective, failing to get to the heart of the matter.
meaning.zh: 隔着靴子挠痒痒，比喻说话、做事不中肯，没有抓住要害。

equivalents: not get to the heart of the matter

examples.zh: 这份报告只谈表面现象，简直是隔靴搔痒。
examples.en: The report only deals with surface issues — it completely misses the point.

examples.zh: 这样的批评隔靴搔痒，解决不了问题。
examples.en: Criticism like this skirts the real issue and solves nothing.

meaning.en: As plain as if held up for all to see (usually of hidden motives).
meaning.zh: 形容真相完全暴露，多指阴谋、用心。

examples.zh: 他的野心已昭然若揭。
examples.en: His ambition is now plain for all to see.

examples.zh: 对方的真实意图昭然若揭。
examples.en: Their real intentions have been laid bare.

story.en: Zhuangzi describes someone who parades his virtues 'as brightly as if carrying the sun and moon aloft' (昭昭乎若揭日月而行).
story.zh: 《庄子·达生》：“昭昭乎若揭日月而行也。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指坏的用心。

meaning.en: Words spoken from the bottom of one's heart.
meaning.zh: 发自内心的真诚话。

examples.zh: 这些都是我的肺腑之言，希望你能听进去。
examples.en: I mean every word of this — I hope you'll listen.

examples.zh: 老师的肺腑之言让学生们深受感动。
examples.en: The teacher's heartfelt words moved the students deeply.

meaning.en: Talented people appreciating and valuing one another.
meaning.zh: 比喻性格、才能相近的人互相爱惜、敬重。

examples.zh: 两位棋手虽是对手，却惺惺相惜。
examples.en: Though rivals, the two players have great mutual respect.

examples.zh: 他们惺惺相惜，成了一生的好友。
examples.en: Kindred spirits, they became lifelong friends.

meaning.en: Sorrow and joy, partings and reunions — the vicissitudes of life.
meaning.zh: 悲伤、欢乐、离别、团聚，泛指人生的种种遭遇。

examples.zh: 这部小说讲述了一个家庭的悲欢离合。
examples.en: The novel tells of a family's joys and sorrows.

examples.zh: 人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺。
examples.en: People have their sorrows and joys, partings and reunions; the moon waxes and wanes.

origin.source: 苏轼《水调歌头·明月几时有》

story.en: Su Shi: 'People have their sorrows and joys, partings and reunions; the moon has dim and bright, full and waning phases.'
story.zh: 苏轼《水调歌头》：“人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全。”

usage.en: Object or subject. Famous in Su Shi's 水调歌头.
usage.zh: 多作宾语、主语。苏轼《水调歌头》有“人有悲欢离合”。

meaning.en: An isolated army fighting on alone; to struggle single-handed.
meaning.zh: 孤立无援的军队奋勇作战，比喻一个人或一个集体独自奋斗。

examples.zh: 这个项目全靠他孤军奋战。
examples.en: He's fighting a lone battle on this project.

examples.zh: 队友受伤后，她只能孤军奋战。
examples.en: After her teammate was injured, she had to go it alone.

meaning.en: Remote mountains and dense old forests.
meaning.zh: 偏远的大山和古老的森林。

examples.zh: 他们在深山老林里迷了路。
examples.en: They got lost deep in the mountains.

examples.zh: 这种珍稀植物只生长在深山老林中。
examples.en: This rare plant only grows in remote forests.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，常用在“在”“到”后。

meaning.en: To rush about here and there, busy with some task.
meaning.zh: 到处奔走，多指为某事忙碌。

examples.zh: 为了筹款，他整天东奔西走。
examples.en: He spends all day rushing around trying to raise money.

examples.zh: 她东奔西跑，终于给孩子找到了学校。
examples.en: After running from pillar to post, she finally found a school for her child.

meaning.en: Originally refinement and substance in balance; now gentle, cultured and courteous in manner.
meaning.zh: 原指文采和实质配合得当，现形容人举止文雅有礼。

examples.zh: 他戴着眼镜，看上去文质彬彬的。
examples.en: With his glasses, he looks every inch the gentleman.

examples.zh: 这位文质彬彬的教授讲课十分风趣。
examples.en: The refined professor is very witty in class.

story.en: Confucius: 'When refinement and substance are in balance, then you have a gentleman' (文质彬彬，然后君子).
story.zh: 《论语·雍也》：“质胜文则野，文胜质则史。文质彬彬，然后君子。”

meaning.en: To prostrate oneself in worship; to idolise blindly.
meaning.zh: 佛教最高的敬礼，比喻对人或事物极端崇拜。

examples.zh: 他对名牌顶礼膜拜。
examples.en: He worships designer brands.

examples.zh: 不能对权威顶礼膜拜。
examples.en: We mustn't bow down blindly before authority.

meaning.en: Headaches and fevers; minor ailments.
meaning.zh: 泛指一般的小病。

examples.zh: 有个头疼脑热的，去社区医院就行。
examples.en: For minor ailments, just go to the community clinic.

examples.zh: 孩子一有头疼脑热，妈妈就着急。
examples.en: Whenever the child has a sniffle, Mum gets anxious.

usage.en: Object or attributive; often 有个头疼脑热.
usage.zh: 多作宾语、定语，常说“有个头疼脑热”。
